study_title: Cross-lingual hallucination detection on a dual-reviewed length-controlled HaluEval benchmark
research_question: Does evidence-conditioned hallucination detection and calibration differ between English and simplified Chinese after candidate-length and answer-style artifacts are controlled?
primary_hypothesis: Held-out Matthews correlation coefficient differs between English and simplified Chinese for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the controlled benchmark.
test_set_policy: Freeze source-pair split before detector inference.
Do not inspect test labels while changing prompts, thresholds, or calibration methods.
Fit thresholds and calibrators on development pairs only.
Report the length-only baseline in every primary result table.
Describe any analysis added after result inspection as exploratory.
replication_policy: A cross-lingual claim should be replicated on at least one additional open-weight model family before submission or described as Qwen-specific.
